name: file-upload

frames.best_why: File row is fully shown with name, size, type and modified date under the heading.

tagline: A dark dropzone whose pale tile shifts aside to show your uploaded file.
summary: A rounded upload panel with a faint grid, a heading and a small tile with an upload arrow. Hovering nudges the tile and draws a dashed outline, and a chosen file becomes a details row.
appearance: A dark rounded upload panel with a faint square grid behind the content, a white 'Upload file' heading and a grey instruction line. Below sits a small pale square with an upload arrow; once a file is added it becomes a wide dark row.
behaviour: Hovering the pale square nudges it up and right while a dashed cyan outline appears. Choosing a file swaps the square for a full-width row showing the filename, size, type and modified date.
demo_content: Heading 'Upload file', a drag-or-click instruction, and a chosen cover-1.png of 0.84 MB.
search_phrases: upload area with dashed drop outline
file picker with name and size list
attach a document by dropping it
click or drag to add a file
single attachment slot for a form
use_when: A form needs a forgiving single-file drop target that also works by click.
avoid_when: It accepts one file at a time, and the list is local only, with no progress or remove control.
customise: Only an onChange callback is exposed. All copy, the grid, the hover nudge and the file-row layout are written into the file.
weight_why: A dropzone, one animated tile and a small static grid of divs.

a11y.note: The hidden input has no label and the dropzone has no visible focus ring; a chosen file is not announced.

issues: The file row has no remove, progress or error state once a file is chosen.
polish_why: Tidy dropzone and clear file row; the uploaded state has no remove or progress feedback.
title: File Upload
